experiments.scope: Reduced-width run of the filed attempt's own walk on the selected Orchard Poseidon target at its own round count: on the input line message(v + rho) on which rounds 0 and 1 are affine, the walk v -> first 10 bits of the digest is run to its first repeat and the two distinct values leading into it are returned as messages; the event is that the first 10 bits of the big-endian reading of the 32-byte digest agree for the two distinct canonical messages. No full collision is expected or claimed.
experiments.hypothesis: The walk on the line at this round count repeats after about 40 evaluations, as a random 10-bit function would, and every trial returns a pair whose digests agree on those 10 bits. Checks the row's own line map and round function at one reduced width; it says nothing about the full-width map, the cost or the success probability.
